{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-ttfo.9","title":"process_dio keeps stale parent when _admissible rejects a DAGRank-inadmissible update","description":"## Location

python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py DodagState.process_dio — after the poison and raw dio.rank >= self.rank eviction branches, the new _admissible gate:

    candidate = ParentCandidate(neighbor_id, dio.rank, link_etx)
    if not self._admissible(candidate):
        return
    self.parents[neighbor_id] = candidate

Contrast the raw-inflation branch just above it (ttfo.3), which pops an existing parent and calls select_parent().

## What goes wrong

The DAGRank/floor port (ttfo.8) correctly refuses first-join of below-root ranks and of candidates whose DAGRank does not strictly increase. For an already-installed parent, _admissible False is treated as "do not insert" rather than "this advertisement makes the parent unusable." The cached lower rank stays; select_parent is not run.

RFC 6550 8.2.2.4 requires DAGRank(node) > DAGRank(parent) against the advertised Rank. Keeping the stale advertisement violates that once the parent's new DAGRank has caught up to ours.

Not a refile of ttfo.3 (that path is dio.rank >= self.rank raw, and it now evicts) or ttfo.8 (first-join below-root / missing DAGRank predicate — those predicates are in _admissible and first-join is rejected).

## Trigger (reproduced)

link_etx=1.5 is already used by test_does_not_switch_without_meaningful_improvement. With MinHopRankIncrease 256:

1. process_dio(rank=256, P1, etx=1.5) -> JOINED, own rank 640 (DAGRank 2), cached P1.rank=256 (DAGRank 1).
2. process_dio(rank=600, P1, etx=1.5) -> 600 < 640 so the raw ttfo.3 eviction does not fire; _admissible fails because 600//256 == 640//256 == 2; return without pop.
3. Actual: still JOINED at 640, parents[P1].rank still 256.
4. Expected: P1 removed, re-select (UNJOINED if no backup).

When own rank is a multiple of mhri (the etx=1.0 / parent-rank-256 happy path), DAGRank equality coincides with dio.rank >= self.rank and ttfo.3 covers it. The hole is exactly the non-aligned ranks the DAGRank port exists to handle.

Same return also retains a legal cached parent after a later below-root advertisement (rank=100 following a rank-256 join).

New neighbors at the same DAGRank are correctly not inserted (P2 rank 600 while own rank 640 stays out of parents).

## Fix

When _admissible is False and neighbor_id is already in self.parents, pop and select_parent(), matching the poison / raw-inflation branches. Optionally use DAGRank for that eviction test rather than only the insert gate. Add a process_dio test with independently computed ranks (256 + round(1.5*256)=640, then 600) — do not use node._admissible(...) as the oracle.

node_address coerce in __post_init__ is clean (mixed textual forms of the same IID now compare equal after to_ipv6).
